primary_source.author: Alan Horwitz
primary_source.title: Invariant Means
original_pdf_locations: Section 1, printed pages 1–2: continuous mean definition and separate strictness property
Abstract and Section 1: exact type 1 and type 2 identities
primary_source.html_numbering_note: The conversion labels the same classification Conjecture 26; the original PDF labels it Conjecture 29. Both were read; original PDF relevant pages visually inspected.

source_scope: The literal continuous-mean classification, without an added strictness/analyticity condition. Minimum is a non-strict witness, and no strengthened strict classification is decided.

prior_attribution.credit: Horwitz is credited for the source question. The minimum construction and elementary lattice identities are standard. No new-to-literature or priority claim is made; empty MathDB replies are not evidence of novelty.

formal_model: Source continuous internal means on positive orthants, all-permutation symmetry, exact two invariance types, and absence of even the larger class of inverse arithmetic pair representations (without monotonicity). The inverse-to-generator bridge is proved locally.

formal_audit.qualification: Compilation only; independent review and paper required before counting.
